name: preflight
description: Pre-mortem risk map: find how your plan fails before it does. Drag risks onto a likelihood-and-damage grid, run 2,000 survival simulations, and explore a 3D universe. Built with plain JavaScript, Node and MongoDB.

paragraphs: Preflight is a pre-mortem tool. You imagine your plan has already failed, list every reason why, and drag each cause onto a map of how likely it is against how damaging it would be. It then runs 2,000 simulations of your plan and tells you the odds it survives.

The project has two separate parts: a static client (one HTML file) and a small server that stores plans in a database (MongoDB or SQLite). Behind the app sits a draggable 3D universe you can open and explore.
features: Risk map: drag glowing orbs across a likelihood and damage grid. Score, size and colour update live.
Plan danger score: one number from 0 to 100 with a gradient meter and a flight rank, from "Cleared for takeoff" to "Mayday".
Survival simulation: runs 2,000 trials and shows the chance your plan survives, with a histogram of calm and disaster runs.
Next best move: points at the highest-danger risk you have not handled yet.
Handled risks: mark a risk as handled and its danger drops by 70%.
